query:
SELECT b.id
                 FROM messages m
                 JOIN bot_apps b
                   ON b.bot_user_id = m.user_id
                   OR b.id = (SELECT h.app_id FROM hooks h
                               WHERE h.id::text = m.metadata->'bot'->>'hook_id')
                WHERE m.id = $1 AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
                LIMIT 1
